author: Unity
description:
Discover how the developers of Monster Walk, launched in October 2025 on iOS and Android, used Unity to bridge fitness and gaming by turning real-world steps into gameplay. 

In this video, Talofa Games CEO Jenny Xu explains the technical challenges and development decisions behind creating a seamless, background experience, including how the team uses Unity hooks for OnApplicationFocus and OnApplicationPause to save game state.
 
[00:00] Intro
[00:56] Consolidating step data streams
[02:39] Optimizing battery life

author: Unity
description:
Unity Addressables makes it easy to load assets without rebuilding your entire application. In this quick tip, you’ll learn how and why to organize them based on when they’re required at runtime, rather than by asset type.

Make sure to watch the full linked video tutorial. 

Learn more: https://on.unity.com/addressables

#GameDev #UnityLearn #UnityTips #UnityAddressables
title: Organize assets with Addressables
